scripts.docker:push: TAG=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && docker tag ijimiguel/my-json-server:$TAG ijimiguel/my-json-server:latest && docker push ijimiguel/my-json-server:$TAG && docker push ijimiguel/my-json-server:latest
scripts.docker:release: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:pull && npm run docker:stop && npm run docker:compose
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run docker:release && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run docker:release && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run docker:release && git push --follow-tags
